messages.subject: Controlling margin
parts:
Hi,

I have a question on how to control margin around a plot. For example,
take any plot here http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/geom_freqpoly.html

Here you see there are some blank spece where the black-line starts
in left portion of the plot and also some blank space where that line
ends in the right side. I want to remove those space i.e. I want line
should start just on the left edge of the start and ends on the right
edge.

Can anyone please guide me how to do that adjustment?

Thanks,

messages.author: 9e1d805a26f6d719
messages.subject: Re: Controlling margin
parts:
Here's one way to do it. Just coord_cartesian to affect the axes
(without affecting the data):

qplot(carat, data = diamonds, geom="freqpoly", binwidth = 0.1) +
coord_cartesian(xlim=c(min(diamonds$carat), max(diamonds$carat)))

-Harlan
